notes.title: Update: Languages and more!
notes.notes:
Hello MouseBotters!  Our first patch is now out.  We fixed a number of issues, the biggest of which is that now European languages are supported (well, some of them anyway...)

Changes in this build:

 German, Italian, French and Spanish are now supported.
 Game now pauses when a controller is disconnected
 Miscellaneous itty bitty fixes.
